title: Retention
intro: Each record class has a retention action. Every class starts as "Keep". Business records, audit and snapshots are always kept. Periods must be agreed with Mobily IT.

reference.label: IT approval reference
reference.help: Record the reference of the approval Mobily IT gave outside this platform, for example a change ticket. Saving it does not approve anything.

effect.inbox: Archived read notifications can no longer be marked unread. With "Archive, then delete" they disappear from the inbox.

run.dryRunHelp: Shows what a run would archive or delete. Nothing is changed.
run.runHelp: Archives the records of every enabled class that are past their period and, for "Archive, then delete", deletes the live rows. Each action is logged.

requestedVia.label: Requested by
requestedVia.api: A person, on this screen or the API

run.requested: The request was recorded. Its status is shown in the list below.
run.empty: No run or dry run has been requested yet.
run.unknownUntilDone: Counts and checksums are unknown until the run has finished.
run.noArchiveSet: No archive set (a dry run writes none)

actions.title: Actions in this run
actions.empty: This run has logged no action.

archived.title: Archived records
archived.intro: Each record a run archived, with the run and archive set that hold its copy. A record that was not deleted stays read-only.
archived.filterTableHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores, for example inbox_notification.
archived.filterTableInvalid: Enter a table name in lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

backups.title: Backup sets
backups.readOnly: Backups and restores are run by IT with the backup scripts. This list is read-only.
backups.none: No backup set has been reported yet.
backups.label: Label

class.readOnly: You can see this class but not change it.
class.fixed: This class is always kept. Its action cannot be changed.
class.periodHint: A whole number from 1 to 36500. Leave it empty while IT has not agreed a period.
class.periodInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 36500, or leave it empty.
class.referenceInvalid: Enter at least 3 and at most 500 characters, or leave it empty.
class.saved: Saved. The class now shows the values the server stored.
class.notApproval: Changing a class records a technical setting. It does not grant a business, Finance or IT approval.

common.noPermission: You do not have the right to see this part.
